Name: T3 Deck
Author: alejandrom2
Description: Watch and steer T3 Code threads from Stream Deck: thread status, stop, prompts, model options and answers, across every provider.

Actions.Name: Activity
Actions.Tooltip: The most urgent thread matching a filter. Tap opens it in T3 Code.

Actions.Name: New Thread
Actions.Tooltip: Starts a new thread in the selected thread's project, no project, or a chosen one; with a saved prompt or empty.

Actions.Name: Send Prompt
Actions.Tooltip: Sends a saved prompt to the selected thread. Hold to interrupt and restart with it.

Actions.Name: Steer
Actions.Tooltip: Adds a saved instruction to the selected thread's running turn.

Actions.Name: Quick Prompt
Actions.Tooltip: Sends an everyday prompt to the selected thread: continue, fix tests, diagnose, explain, commit, or your own.

Actions.Name: Stop
Actions.Tooltip: Stops the running turn of the thread selected in T3 Code.

Actions.Name: Model
Actions.Tooltip: Switches the selected thread to a favorite model, or to the next of T3 Code's favorites.

Actions.Name: Effort
Actions.Tooltip: Sets the selected thread's reasoning effort, or steps through what its model offers.

Actions.Name: Speed
Actions.Tooltip: Toggles fast mode on the selected thread where its model offers it.

Actions.Name: Permissions
Actions.Tooltip: Sets the selected thread's access, from Supervised to Full access, or steps through them.

Actions.Name: Plan
Actions.Tooltip: Switches the selected thread between Build and Plan.

Actions.Name: Approve
Actions.Tooltip: Answers the selected thread's approval as far as its settings allow, or opens it in T3 Code.

Actions.Name: Deny
Actions.Tooltip: Declines the selected thread's approval.

Actions.Name: Thread
Actions.Tooltip: One thread from the board, filled by key position: status, title and timer. Tap opens it in T3 Code; hold selects it.

Actions.Name: Organize
Actions.Tooltip: Settles, pins, snoozes, archives or marks the selected thread unread.

Actions.Name: Pull Request
Actions.Tooltip: The selected thread's pull request and its state. Tap opens it.

Actions.Name: Branch
Actions.Tooltip: The selected thread's branch. Tap opens the thread in T3 Code.

Actions.Name: Commit
Actions.Tooltip: Commits the selected thread's changes, or also pushes them or opens a PR, with T3 Code's commit message unless you set one.

Actions.Name: Push
Actions.Tooltip: Pushes the selected thread's branch. Hold to push.

Actions.Name: Create PR
Actions.Tooltip: Pushes the selected thread's branch and opens a pull request for it. Hold to create.

Actions.Name: Pull
Actions.Tooltip: Pulls the selected thread's branch when it is behind its upstream.

Actions.Name: Fix Findings
Actions.Tooltip: Sends T3 Code's Fix findings task for the selected thread's pull request: unresolved reviews and failing checks. Hold to send.

Actions.Name: Explain PR
Actions.Tooltip: Asks the selected thread to walk through its pull request, as T3 Code's Explain does.

Actions.Name: Ask about PR
Actions.Tooltip: Opens the thread that holds the pull request in T3 Code, to ask about it there.

Actions.Name: Review Guide
Actions.Tooltip: Writes T3 Code's review guide for the selected thread's pull request, then opens the thread.

Actions.Name: Open in Editor
Actions.Tooltip: Opens the selected thread's worktree or project in an editor, on the machine T3 Code runs on.

Actions.Name: Health
Actions.Tooltip: The connection to T3 Code: ready, connecting, needs pairing or failing. Tap reconnects.

Actions.Name: Limits
Actions.Tooltip: A provider's subscription limit, pooled like T3 Code's Limits: % left, next reset and banked resets. Tap refreshes; hold opens T3 Code's Usage or uses a reset.

Actions.Name: Usage
Actions.Tooltip: A period's API-estimate cost, tokens and sessions, as T3 Code's Usage shows them, on one machine or all. Tap refreshes; hold also reloads model prices.

Actions.Name: Threads Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate through the threads that match its filter, selecting them in T3 Code; press or tap to open one.

Actions.Name: Power Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Changes the selected thread's model, effort or access; press or tap switches Speed where offered.

Actions.Name: Prompts Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate through your prompts and templates. Press sends to the selected thread; hold starts a new thread.

Actions.Name: Answer Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Answers an agent's question choice by choice, and approvals as far as its settings allow.

Actions.Name: PR Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate through open pull requests. Press runs Fix findings, tap opens it in the browser, touch and hold reads its findings.

Actions.Name: Limits Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate through every provider's limit windows. Press or tap refreshes; hold the press to open T3 Code's Usage or use a reset.

Actions.Name: Usage Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate through a period's total and each model's cost, tokens, cache hit rate and cost per million tokens. Press or tap refreshes; a long press reloads model prices.
